result.title: They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification
result.summary: The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes_of_SKR-ID.

AI.brief_summary: 系统分析 VLM 在相对位姿识别中的稳定输出偏差，并提出免标注的 SKR-ID：以去偏的物体中心 prompt 冷启动，再用中位数 logit 作动态阈值做递归排序，把输出从 next-token 预测改为任务分类头，使开源 VLM 的 Macro-F1 由 35.0–45.4% 升至 53.7–58.0%。
AI.relevance_reason: 「看得见却说不出」正对应视觉证据已进入内部状态却未被答案使用的缺口，可作为输出偏置与视觉旁路的诊断参照；其 logit 阈值式去偏是否真正恢复证据使用、而非仅校正先验，仍需核查。
